title: Thai Tiger Prawn Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Thai dish featuring succulent prawns cooked with tiger prawn sauce, served with a side of fried rice.
instructions: Heat the slovakian tiger prawn oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the prawns and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the prawns from the skillet and set aside.
Add the Thai tiger prawn sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the fried rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Return the prawns to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with Thai basil and serve immediately.
Cook the fried rice according to package instructions before using.
Adjust the amount of Thai tiger prawn sauce to taste.
